bias.en: Downtrend · lost $158.4, oversold above the $148.8 low
bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · 跌破 $158.4，在 $148.8 低点上方超卖

read.en: Nvidia fell 4.1% on Nov 16 to $156.14, trading $155.02–163.00 on heavy volume (1.58x the 20-day average). It is below the 5-day ($165.6), 10-day ($178.2), 30-day ($205.8), 100-day ($211.9) and 200-day ($204.0), all falling. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12, below zero, histogram flat; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 13 ($172.00), and RSI is 22.7, deeply oversold.
read.zh: 英伟达 11月16日下跌 4.1%，收于 $156.14，盘中区间 $155.02–163.00，成交放量（20 日均量的 1.58 倍）。股价位于 5 日（$165.6）、10 日（$178.2）、30 日（$205.8）、100 日（$211.9）和 200 日均线（$204.0）下方，均在下行。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图持平；抛物线 SAR 自 10月13日起看空（$172.00），RSI 为 22.7，深度超卖。

read.en: The drop broke the $158.4–160 support (Nov 13 low, round number), now resistance, leaving the Nov 12 low ($148.80) as the next floor. Resistance is $158.4–160, then $163–166.2 (Nov 16 high, 5-day, Nov 12 close) and $170–172 (Nov 13 high, SAR). Support is $155 (Nov 16 low), then $148.8 (52-week low). A close above $163 would target $165.6–166.2; below $155, $148.8.
